goalDescription: Die lernende Person kann die Rolle von sozialen Netzwerken und Sozialkapital im gesellschaftlichen Wandel beschreiben.
reviewerModel: Codex; exact serving model identifier not exposed
aspectRatioDecision: Close native16:9 landscape; no exception needed. Format not mechanically normalized.

actualInspection.fachlichePruefung: Close support from friends/family and a teacher or occupational mentor illustrate different network resources. The branching opportunities and explicit note that access can differ avoid implying automatic employment, deserved superiority or universal equal access.
actualInspection.phone: At 360 px the two support groups, connected learner, path sign and open/questioned network are clear. Small speech words supplement the main scenes.
actualInspection.desktop: At 680 px everyday support and bridging information/opportunity can be distinguished with the conditional mentor phrase.
actualInspection.actorPerspective: The mentor holds a tablet with its plain back facing the audience; people face their discussion partners. Signposts correctly face the common path view.
actualInspection.style: Friendly clear comic raster, coherent broad colors and approachable people, without photorealism or sterile technical restyling.

interpretationLimits: The connections symbolize possible trust, support and information, not guaranteed success or a complete formal definition of social capital.
goalTextStatus: Actual current canonical German title/description inspected and matched to bilingual E1 author candidate; no D/P gate attested by this image review.
